candidates.mechanism: Strictly initialize the depth12 typed hierarchy backbone from the pinned Trinity d192 release, then train the typed L0-L3 hierarchy on the frozen 20k-case ceiling.
candidates.status_note: Canonical seed21 has a strong Official-100 mean win, but training seed/order sensitivity remains and paired intervals cross zero. It is a mechanism candidate, not seed-stable SOTA.
candidates.next_gate: Anchor-preserving low-backbone-LR repair, then full-data finalist and external routed-PPA certification.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Remove intermediate hard projection and apply one terminal projection after the per-block flow. The endpoint-reinterpolation arm was also screened and failed its primary quick point.
rejected_screens.reason: The NFE4/refiner400 mean gain reverses at NFE4/refiner1600 in both primary metrics; no full-data or multiseed promotion is allowed.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Select among two matched-budget proposals using a pinned OpenROAD global-place wirelength response instead of p2b HPWL.
rejected_screens.reason: The pilot has one near-p2b tie resolution with -3.47% estimated global-place WL, no discriminative-p2b case, and insufficient design-level evidence. Response cost is too high for U2 or deployed selection.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Order-conditioned group staging trained from scratch on the frozen 5k subset.
rejected_screens.reason: Scratch training regressed both primary metrics at 2k/refiner400. The module is retained only for a separate production-checkpoint warm-start repair.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Warm-start the same production checkpoint for both arms, then learn cluster order phases through a zero-gated block residual.
rejected_screens.reason: At 2k/refiner400, cost regressed 0.51% and V_rel regressed 11.10% versus the matched warm-start control. Group-order phasing is not the missing trajectory mechanism.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Feed predicted L0 boundary and L1 group states into the L2 block trajectory through a zero-gated bottleneck residual.
rejected_screens.reason: The mean cost gain is long-tail driven: the cost median and V_rel regress, and both primary intervals cross zero. The frozen quick gate rejects the mechanism.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Feed predicted port offsets back into incident block trajectories through the existing sparse port-block incidence.
rejected_screens.reason: The path is balanced across cases and slightly improves the cost median and V_rel, but mean cost regresses 1.26% and both primary intervals cross zero. It fails the frozen quick gate.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Feed a differentiable 16x16 occupancy and exact-area pressure field back into block trajectories.
rejected_screens.reason: Both primary metrics regress at the frozen quick gate, with a cost interval above zero. The occupancy-field path is rejected.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Freeze the production model and train only the M13 port-consensus adapter on the frozen 5k subset.
rejected_screens.reason: The isolated adapter regresses both primary metrics against the untouched production checkpoint, so whole-model drift does not explain the M13 rejection.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Send the reverse target message on each undirected b2b edge using the existing graph-message operator.
rejected_screens.reason: Symmetric edge messages regress both primary metrics versus matched control with intervals excluding zero. The production directional message function must be retained.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Allocate complexity-scaled sparse relational slots from the existing hierarchy router and inject their routed context into block trajectories.
rejected_screens.reason: The isolated frozen-base adapter regresses both primary metrics. The 101-120 block stratum is worst at +17.18% cost, so the sparse-slot reuse path is rejected.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Apply a low-rank relational expert to blocks gated by normalized b2b and p2b degree.
rejected_screens.reason: The expert improves cost only on 81-100 blocks and regresses V_rel there. Both aggregate primary metrics fail, while the 101-120 tail remains worse.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Add a top-25% per-case physics tail penalty to the existing mean objective without adding model parameters.
rejected_screens.reason: Cost improves while V_rel regresses 13.09%; most cases are unchanged in V_rel and the objective does not stabilize the intended tail.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Apply a predeclared composite routing/cluster/overlap/boundary/area gradient during NFE4 sampling.
rejected_screens.reason: The composite energy remains misaligned with legalized objectives and strongly regresses HPWL and grouping.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Apply normalized routing-proxy gradients at every NFE4 flow step with scale 0.02.
rejected_screens.reason: The proxy gradient improves p2b strongly but destabilizes grouping and boundary, regressing both primary metrics.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Increase hierarchy structural trajectory supervision from 0.1 to 0.3.
rejected_screens.reason: Cost improves, but V_rel regresses at confirmation; the quick V_rel gain does not persist.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Resume each 200k seed from 20k to 40k steps.
rejected_screens.reason: Longer training improves mean V_rel but leaves cost neutral and does not make all seeds improve both metrics; pooled CIs cross zero.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Interpolate seed21 raw and EMA weights at alpha 0.75 and 0.90.
rejected_screens.reason: Full EMA is the best state; both predeclared blends regress, monotonic toward EMA.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Use the raw model state instead of EMA for the seed21 200k checkpoint.
rejected_screens.reason: Raw state is worse than EMA on both primary metrics; EMA is not the cause of the seed21 reversal.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Equal-weight average of the three 200k seed checkpoints, with a matched 50k soup control.
rejected_screens.reason: Weight averaging destroys the learned optimum in both 200k and 50k soups; the 200k soup also loses to its matched 50k soup.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Keep seed21 initialization but train the 200k arm with data_seed19.
rejected_screens.reason: Changing data order does not rescue seed21; both primary metrics still regress slightly despite a grouping gain.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Train the same typed hierarchy on the audited 200k cache instead of 50k.
rejected_screens.reason: Two seeds improve both metrics, but seed21 reverses and pooled case-clustered intervals cross zero; the Trinity gap remains positive on both metrics.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Combine balanced_stream sampling with the learned netlist edge gate.
rejected_screens.reason: The combination does not beat both single mechanisms on both primary metrics and is rejected before confirmation.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Ramp the grouping proxy to 0.02 between steps 3000 and 5000 on top of the netlist edge gate.
rejected_screens.reason: The delayed grouping term worsens both primary metrics and grouping relative to the edge-gate arm.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Zero-initialized learned compatibility gate on b2b source-to-target messages inside the existing GraphMessageBlock.
rejected_screens.reason: The subset candidate passed both screens, but full data improves cost and structural HPWL while grouping drives a V_rel regression; it fails the full primary gate.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Keep single-edge boundary-axis locking while allowing corner-coded blocks to move on both axes.
rejected_screens.reason: Corner release reduces but does not remove the seed19 legalizer regression; both primary metrics and boundary still worsen.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Lock x movement for left/right boundary-coded blocks and y movement for top/bottom boundary-coded blocks during sampler overlap separation.
rejected_screens.reason: The mechanism passed both primary metrics on seed23 but regressed all primary and boundary metrics on seed19; it is rejected for seed instability.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Blend refined latents 25% toward the existing hard-projector output.
rejected_screens.reason: The softer blend does not resolve the projection/grouping conflict and regresses both primary metrics plus boundary.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Reapply the existing hard-constraint projector after the closed-form refiner.
rejected_screens.reason: Boundary improves slightly, but cost, V_rel, HPWL, p2b and grouping regress; the mechanism fails the quick primary-metric gate.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Cycle block counts and draw training cases without replacement inside each count queue.
rejected_screens.reason: The full-data candidate improves cost and structural metrics but fails the required simultaneous V_rel improvement.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Enable the existing differentiable soft-MST grouping proxy with weight 0.1.
rejected_screens.reason: Cost regressed strongly at the confirmation budget despite a V_rel gain.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Per-type attention logit biases for global, structural, constraint and port memory.
rejected_screens.reason: The quick gain reversed on the larger matched budget; both primary metrics regressed.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Increase annealed hierarchy bbox supervision from 0.5 to 1.0.
rejected_screens.reason: V_rel improved but cost regressed, so the mechanism fails the primary gate.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Increase typed netlist message passing from one to two layers.
rejected_screens.reason: The quick gain reversed on the larger matched training/refiner budget; cost regressed despite a small V_rel gain.
Legalized cost regressed 2.59% and V_rel changed only -0.24%.
Proxy improved on all three cases, but congestion regressed on all three.
Passed the 5k legalized screen but lost both metrics at the 20k finalist.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Zero-gated sparse active-edge geometry relay over the current per-block b2b/p2b state.
rejected_screens.reason: The quick mean gain does not survive confirmation: V_rel regresses and cost improves only through a mean/outlier trade-off.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Use 0.1x LR for the pretrained Trinity backbone and 1x LR for typed modules.
rejected_screens.reason: The recipe repairs most of seed20's regression but still loses both anchor metrics. Do not sweep the LR; retain it as evidence that backbone drift contributes to heterogeneity.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Train the registered M27 finalist on the full 50k split for 20k steps.
rejected_screens.reason: Long fine-tuning erodes the anchor: cost loses slightly while V_rel improves, and both paired intervals cross zero. Full data cannot select another recipe.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Freeze the Trinity backbone and train only typed graph and hierarchy modules.
rejected_screens.reason: Full freezing prevents needed adaptation and loses both metrics.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Equal-weight average of M27 training seeds 19/20/21 from the same Trinity initialization.
rejected_screens.reason: Checkpoint averaging does not merge the seed solutions into an anchor-beating model.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Parameter seed20 with fixed data order seed21.
rejected_screens.reason: Fixing data order improves seed20 but does not reproduce seed21. Typed parameter initialization remains the dominant seed factor.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Fix typed initialization seed21 and vary data order.
rejected_screens.reason: Data-order sensitivity remains large after fixing typed initialization. Stop seed/order search and report the canonical deterministic recipe with the full negative set.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Train the block trajectory from the exact shelf source_latent consumed by deployment.
rejected_screens.reason: Block-only source alignment improves cost and p2b strongly, but grouping and boundary regress enough to lose V_rel. Retain as causal evidence for coherent hierarchy-source initialization.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Derive L0/L1/L3 source states from the shelf block source so the complete hierarchy begins on a coherent, target-free manifold.
rejected_screens.reason: Coherent source levels recover most of M20's V_rel loss and improve grouping, but the remaining +1.21% V_rel regression fails the quick gate.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Train from a 0.1 Gaussian perturbation of the shelf source and derive coherent L0/L1/L3 source states from that source.
rejected_screens.reason: The quick gain is tail-driven and reverses at 5k/refiner1600. Source-contract repair alone does not remove the long-budget convergence ceiling.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Increase the typed hierarchy backbone from 10 to the Trinity d192 anchor's 12 layers while keeping hidden width and typed conditioning.
rejected_screens.reason: Depth12 passes the 2k quick screen but regresses at the 5k confirmation on only 5k unique cases. The run is retained as a possible subset-overfitting failure and is followed by the separate 20k-case M24 diagnosis.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Repeat the depth10 versus depth12 comparison with 5k training steps over a frozen 20k-case ceiling rather than 5k unique cases.
rejected_screens.reason: Plain depth scaling still reverses at confirmation. The dominant regressions are p2b and boundary, not a data-ceiling artifact alone.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Add the existing port-consensus residual directly to the final x0 prediction instead of before the backbone.
rejected_screens.reason: Moving port feedback to the output still worsens both primary metrics, p2b and grouping. Close the port-residual family rather than retuning its gate.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Add a zero-gated final-output expert restricted to boundary-coded blocks.
rejected_screens.reason: The boundary-only correction worsens cost, V_rel and boundary itself. Close local output-patch variants.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Cross-attend predicted L0/L1 state into all Trinity hidden L2 tokens before the backbone.
rejected_screens.reason: Grouping improves but both primary means and local b2b/p2b geometry regress.

rejected_screens.mechanism: Remove explicit state features and use a zero gate with a tanh-bounded hidden-token residual.
rejected_screens.reason: Training-curve gains do not transfer to legalized metrics and the gate remains inactive.

rejected_screens.reason: Mean V_rel and grouping improve, but cost, area and b2b regress.
